text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council appoint a director to the St. Lawrence Market Neighbourhood (BIA) Board of Management and remove directors from the Little Italy and Upper Village BIA Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominee to the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or until successors are appointed: St. Lawrence Market Neighbourhood: Laskar, Masudur 2. Removed the following directors from the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below: Little Italy: Diviesti, Pat Ross, Ashley Upper Village: Brown, Darren Pintaric, Alan
